description: This file declares the StkService class, which is part of the modem simulator in the Android Open Source Project. It defines the interface for handling SIM Toolkit (STK) related commands and interactions within the modem simulation environment.

classes.name: StkService
classes.description: A class representing the SIM Toolkit service within the modem simulator, responsible for handling STK commands and interactions.

methods.name: StkService
methods.description: Constructor for the StkService class, initializing with service ID, channel monitor, and thread looper.

methods.name: ~StkService
methods.description: Default destructor for the StkService class.

methods.name: SetupDependency
methods.description: Sets up dependencies with the associated SimService.

methods.name: HandleReportStkServiceIsRunning
methods.description: Handles the report indicating the STK service is running.

methods.name: HandleSendEnvelope
methods.description: Handles sending an envelope command to the SIM.

methods.name: HandleSendTerminalResponseToSim
methods.description: Handles sending a terminal response to the SIM.

methods.name: InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Initializes the command handlers for various STK commands.

methods.name: GetCurrentSelectItem
methods.description: Retrieves the current selected item element.

methods.name: OnUnsolicitedCommandForTR
methods.description: Handles unsolicited commands related to terminal responses.
